# Kai GitHub Pages site

This folder is the source for [sameehj.github.io/kai](https://sameehj.github.io/kai/). GitHub Actions builds it with Jekyll and publishes the output to GitHub Pages.

## Add a blog post

Create `site/dist/_posts/YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.md`:

```md
---
layout: post
title: A clear title
description: One sentence for search previews.
category: Field notes
---

Write the post in Markdown.
```

Commit and push to `master`. The Pages workflow rebuilds the home page and blog index automatically. Keep capability claims aligned with the project README and escape suite.
